articles.title: مراكز صيانة السيارات المستقلة في الإسكندرية
مراكز صيانة كيا الشيخ زايد وأبو رواش

assertions: New genuine licensed Wikimedia Commons photographs converted to self-hosted WebP, 1 featured and 1 inline per post, photographer and license credit visible in source.
Articles are HTML-published, WordPress REST + action checks confirm 1500+ words, published status and a featured media asset.
Independent live checks confirmed each new URL's own canonical and index/follow robots meta, not Google indexing.
After cache flush, all five URLs were reachable from homepage and from /service-centers/ and /car-showrooms/ navigation.
All named physical local businesses originate from official manufacturer lists or business directory evidence. Listing a business does not imply personal quality endorsement or accreditation.
Geographical expansions are scoped to Alexandria and West Cairo/Sheikh Zayed, not entire Egypt; future articles require separate fresh validation and competitor/GSC queries before publication.
